## Invitations

The outreach recorded 717 invitations. Attendance was 223, representing 31.1 per cent of those invited. The figures provide a summary of participation for the reporting period and distinguish between the total invitation activity and the number who attended.

The attendance figure is reported against the full invitation total to support a clear understanding of engagement. It should be read alongside the contact activity outlined below, which records the use of SMS and reminder messages in connection with the invitations.

## Contact

SMS was used for 607 invitations. A reminder message was also sent to 607 people. These figures indicate the recorded volume of SMS contact and reminder activity associated with the outreach.

The contact information is presented separately from attendance so that invitation, participation and follow-up activity remain clearly distinguished in the report.

Prepared by G. Evans.
